regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-name leadership at the top (Banks, Innovative Pharma & CXO) with a margin of just 0.01 and non-directional rotation (absorption 0.32, breadth 0.18). The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps: false), so the one validated drawdown edge is absent for China A-shares; ranks are a focus lens only. Baseline is humble: high conviction is not warranted, and any leverage of leadership must treat crowding as a cap-only caution.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks/pharma top rotates out to a new leader: if 512400.SS (Industrial Metals) rises into the top-3 eligible set and its score clears 0.6 while breadth stays above 0.3, that would retire the current two-name leadership read. Until that confirmed handoff shows, treat any metal move as noise, not a new narrative.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks rank first (score 0.998) with the highest durability_bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889), but crowding_z 1.78 flags it as crowded and rotation margin over the challenger is just 0.01 with absorption only 0.32. The trend-gate edge is absent here (gate_helps false), so this is a focus-lens lean, not an alpha call. Signal legs: rank, durability_bar, breadth; counterweight: crowded flag caps conviction and any sizing.
theses.dissent: Durability_bar is coincident, the leader's margin over pharma is negligible (0.01), and crowded leaders in a mean-reverting A-share tape have historically round-tripped; the single validated edge (trend gate) explicitly failed here.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 3% or the Banks/pharma score gap flips to pharma before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only challenger within one point of the leader (score 0.988, margin 0.01) and is also crowded (z 1.59) but with lower durability_bar (0.6) and breadth (0.643) than Banks. The near-parity margin and non-directional rotation make this a confirmed-handoff watch rather than a standalone edge; both leaders sit inside the same narrow top.
theses.dissent: Lower durability and breadth than Banks, also crowded, and with gate_helps false there is no drawdown-control validation behind the tape; the top-two structure may simply be a crowded Financials-Healthcare pair about to churn together.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 4% while Banks extends its lead, before the 20-day check-by date
